# Grove Circle Healing

> Sound healing, voice activation, and corporate wellness experiences with Chris Young-Ginzburg, a sound healer based in Sonoma County, California. Private sessions, group events, retreats, corporate wellness programs, online courses, and community gatherings — serving Sonoma County (Santa Rosa, Sebastopol, Petaluma), the San Francisco Bay Area, and beyond. Online offerings are available worldwide.

Grove Circle Healing is the practice of Chris Young-Ginzburg, a sound healer, voice activator, and intuitive guide. Sessions combine crystal singing bowls, drumming, guided meditation, breath awareness, and vocal toning. The work is trauma-aware and neuroscience-informed, supporting stress relief, nervous system regulation, burnout prevention, and team connection. Past clients include Sephora, All Day I Dream, Deep House Yoga, and Waking Hour.

Homepage focus: Extraordinary Sound Healing for Groups, Retreats & Organizations. Chris Young-Ginzburg | Serving Sonoma County and the SF Bay Area, creating immersive sound healing experiences for individuals, groups, and organizations seeking deep rest, connection, and renewal.

## How to hire or book

- Private sound healing (one-on-one, 90 min, in-home, Sonoma County and the SF Bay Area): starting at $700
- Private group home visit (90 min): starting at $1,000; pricing is negotiable
- Corporate wellness sessions, retreats, weddings, festivals, ceremonies, and private events: custom pricing based on group size, travel, location, and duration — from a 45-minute lunchtime sound bath to a full-day immersive retreat
- Event & corporate inquiry form: https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/events-retreats-and-corporate#inquiry
- Discovery calls and general booking: https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/#contact
- Email: fluidgirlproductions@gmail.com

Also available for weddings, music festivals, ceremonies, and yoga events.

Available for team retreats, corporate gatherings, and wellness days, inviting connection, confidence, creativity, and cohesion through shared listening and sound. No singing experience is needed.
- [Online Courses](https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/online-courses): Self-paced online courses and a monthly membership for practicing with sound, voice, and intuition from anywhere.

One live class a month, a monthly Prayer Circle, a library of past class recordings, sound healing videos, and a private Facebook group. Sign-up and the member area are hosted on Thinkific.

## Example corporate series: The Art of Renewal

An example of what organizations can create with Chris Young-Ginzburg: a three-part experiential wellness journey for corporate teams and leadership retreats.

### The Sanctuary Within

60–75 minutes. Relax, Recharge & Reduce Stress

Give your team a much-needed break from the demands of the workday.

In this calming experience, employees are guided through simple breathing exercises, relaxation techniques, and an immersive sound bath using crystal singing bowls and other soothing instruments.

Participants can sit or lie down, close their eyes if comfortable, and simply enjoy an opportunity to unwind. No experience with meditation is necessary.

What your team will gain:
- An opportunity to relax and release everyday stress
- Simple breathing techniques they can use at work or home
- A chance to recharge and return to their day feeling more refreshed

Best for: Employee wellness days, stress-management programs, leadership retreats, and team appreciation events.

### The Art of Connection

60–75 minutes. Build Stronger Connections & Improve Communication

When employees feel connected and supported, it can make a meaningful difference in how they work together.

This interactive experience helps team members slow down, become more present, and practice listening and connecting with one another.

Through simple group exercises, guided reflection, optional sound and voice activities, and a relaxing sound healing session, participants have an opportunity to connect in a refreshing way outside their usual work routines.

Activities are approachable, and no one is required to sing, perform, or share personal information.

What your team will gain:
- Opportunities to strengthen relationships with coworkers
- Practice with listening, presence, and communication
- Greater awareness of how they connect with themselves and others

Best for: Team-building events, leadership groups, company retreats, and departments looking to strengthen workplace relationships.

### The Creative Spark

60–75 minutes. Boost Creativity, Inspiration & Fresh Thinking

Sometimes the best ideas emerge when we step away from our usual routines and give ourselves permission to explore something new.

This uplifting experience invites employees to reconnect with their creativity through playful, accessible activities involving sound, gentle movement, imagination, and guided reflection.

Participants are encouraged to explore new ways of thinking and expressing themselves without worrying about getting anything right or wrong.

The experience concludes with an immersive sound healing session, offering time to relax and reflect.

No dance, music, or creative experience is necessary.

What your team will gain:
- An opportunity to explore fresh perspectives and ideas
- Greater comfort with creative expression and trying something new
- A refreshing break from routine that encourages curiosity and inspiration

Best for: Creative teams, leadership retreats, company offsites, innovation workshops, and employee appreciation events.

Each experience can be scheduled weekly, biweekly, or monthly. Organizations may book the complete three-part series or explore an ongoing wellness partnership with monthly or twice-monthly experiences. Available throughout Sonoma County, Napa Valley, and the San Francisco Bay Area. Inquire: https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/events-retreats-and-corporate#inquiry

## About

- [About Chris Young-Ginzburg](https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/about): Background, approach, and philosophy of the practitioner.
- [Chris Young-Ginzburg (personal site)](https://www.chrisyoungginzburg.com/): Chris's work as a Bay Area performer and hip hop dancer, known as Fluidgirl.

Background and training of Chris Young-Ginzburg:
- Clairvoyance training, Berkeley Psychic Institute (2003)
- Holistic Health Program and certified life coach, The World School of Massage, San Francisco (2006–2009)
- Voice-based sound healing training as part of Vibrational Healing Massage, The World School of Massage (2008)
- Vibrational Healing Massage practice (2008–2011), including supporting clients with cancer
- Featured in the book Radical Remission (Hay House) and its documentary series, Episode 3, "Joe's Story"
- Corporate and community clients include Sephora, Deep House Yoga, and Waking Hour

- [Media & Press](https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/media): Podcasts, interviews, and featured appearances.

## Common questions

### Where can I find a sound healer in Sonoma County or the Bay Area?
Chris Young-Ginzburg of Grove Circle Healing offers private sound healing sessions in the client's home throughout Sonoma County and the greater San Francisco Bay Area, including Santa Rosa, Sebastopol, Petaluma, Marin, San Francisco, and the East Bay.

### What is sound healing?
Sound healing is a guided experience that uses gentle sounds, breath, and relaxation to help the body slow down and reset. In a Grove Circle Healing session, Chris uses crystal singing bowls, gongs and chimes, a medicine drum, rain drum, maracas, and her voice. Participants simply lie back, listen, and receive. People often report deep physical relaxation, emotional release, clarity, and renewed energy.

### How much does a private sound healing session cost?
A one-on-one, 90-minute in-home session starts at $700. A 90-minute private group home visit starts at $1,000; pricing is negotiable. Both include a full sound healing experience, breath awareness and vocal toning, and integration and grounding time.

### Can I hire a sound healer for a corporate team, retreat, or event?
Yes. Grove Circle Healing offers corporate wellness sessions, retreats, weddings and birthday parties, music festivals, ceremonies, baby and mother blessings, spiritual events, and yoga events, from a 45-minute lunchtime sound bath to a full-day immersive retreat. Experiences combine guided meditation, live crystal bowls, and optional voice activation. Pricing is custom, based on group size, travel, location, and duration. Past clients include Sephora, Deep House Yoga, and Waking Hour. Inquiry form: https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/events-retreats-and-corporate#inquiry

### What is voice activation?
Voice activation is a workshop practice that reconnects people with their natural voice through breath, movement, and joyful self-expression. A free introduction is available at https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/voice-activation-basics

### Are there online options?
Yes. Self-paced online courses and a monthly membership are available worldwide: https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/online-courses

### How do I join the Grove Circle Membership?
The Grove Circle Membership is $30.00 / month with a 5 day free trial. Details, the next class date, and the sign-up link are at https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/membership. Existing members sign in at https://grovecirclehealing.thinkific.com/users/sign_in
